summary: Settlement Report (iteration 79) verified end-to-end. Existing sales-payment-breakdown still present. No horizontal overflow at 1920px (0px) or 390px (0px). Finance user flow: created accounts sub_admin via API, completed magic link, logged in via browser -> lands on /sub-admin/dashboard, nav-sales opens /reports/sales, the SAME settle-* section renders with 660/510 and the Settlement Excel downloads. RBAC deny verified: /master/dashboard and /master/admins both redirect to /sub-admin/dashboard for the finance user.
critical_code_review_comments: per_gateway rows use keys gross_amount/refunded_amount/net_amount, but top-level uses the same *_amount naming - consistent, good. Consider also exposing plain 'gross'/'net' aliases if the frontend expects short keys elsewhere (currently the UI reads *_amount so this is fine).

test_non_sales_sub_admin_denied was skipped because POST /api/admin/sub-admins rejects a permissions list containing only non-sales items ('orders:view'). If the perm whitelist has changed, update the negative-RBAC test to use an accepted non-sales permission so we still cover the 403 path on /api/admin/settlement-report.
